Package frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants

Class SwerveModuleConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.constants.SwerveModuleConstants
public class SwerveModuleConstants extends Object
Per-module hardware configuration for a single swerve module (motor CAN IDs, inversions and CANCoder calibration), consumed by SwerveModuleIOReal and SwerveModuleIOSim.
